Pietro Krohn
sources.publisher: Project Runeberg, digitized from Ord och Bild, 1905

highRiskClaims.claim: Pietro Krohn became the first director of the Kunstindustrimuseum in 1893.
Historical sources identify the work as a pastel.

uncertainties.statement: The locked official object page does not specify the medium; two historical sources identify the work as pastel.
An 1887 exhibition catalogue lists a matching Pietro Krohn pastel under the ownership of Professor E. Krohn, but the complete route into Designmuseum Danmark's collection could not be established.
The official page lists the work in the Director's Choice catalogue but does not state whether it is currently on display.
No accession number was found in the official object page or the supplementary sources used in this search.
